result.reason: Completed static extraction from the supplied files only. The CLI implements HTTP requests and terminal output; separate MCP and store modules implement subprocess communication, configuration management, and local persistence. The backend and dependency implementations are absent. The supplied CLI entry does not import or export the MCP/store modules, although examples import their APIs from that entry. Runtime reachability, downstream tool effects, model routing, and backend retention remain unknown.
result.claim: Control Claude Code through MCP for OpenClaw agents, providing programmatic command execution, file reading and writing, code search, persistent sessions, agent teams, and tool controls.
